articles.title: Petrol, diesel price cut not possible immediately, oil companies face Rs 42,000 crore losses: Union Minister Suresh Gopi
articles.titleEn: Petrol, diesel price cut not possible immediately, oil companies face Rs 42,000 crore losses: Union Minister Suresh Gopi
articles.summary: Union Minister Suresh Gopi has ruled out an immediate reduction in petrol and diesel prices, citing Rs 42,000 crore in losses suffered by oil companies and disruptions in petroleum supplies amid the West Asia conflict. He said states could consider cutting fuel taxes, while the Centre was working to address supply-related challenges.
